args.subject: Resume Template
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I received your request for the resume template. You can download clean and professional resume templates from www.resume-templates.com. There's a download links section available at the website.

Alternatively, you can visit https://www.resume-templates.com/download_links to access the download page directly.

If you any issues accessing the templates, please let me know and I'll try to help further.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
